units: <cite ref="Chullin 47b:15">Ḥull. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>צ׳ דקוניא</he> a glazed earthen plate.

<cite ref="Beitzah 32a:14">Bets. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>צ׳ חקלייתא</he> the dining plates of the peasantry, v. <cite ref="A01603"><he>אִירוֹנִית</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Megillah 7b:4">Meg. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>שתין צ׳ וכ׳</he> sixty plates of sixty different dishes.
